# AST-selected baseline functions only; no module imports or secret configuration.
def parse_lingxing_color(product_name: str) -> str:
    text = (product_name or '').strip()
    if not text:
        return ''
    match = re.search('(\\d+\\s*#\\s*[^#，,;/|]+)', text)
    return re.sub('\\s+', '', match.group(1).strip()) if match else ''

def read_lingxing_color_map() -> Dict[str, str]:
    color_map: Dict[str, str] = {}
    try:
        with db_cursor() as cursor:
            cursor.execute("\n                SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM information_schema.TABLES\n                WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE()\n                  AND TABLE_NAME='lxpm_product_category_snapshot'\n            ")
            if not cursor.fetchone().get('cnt', 0):
                return color_map
            cursor.execute("\n                SELECT sku, product_name\n                FROM `lxpm_product_category_snapshot`\n                WHERE sku IS NOT NULL AND sku != ''\n                  AND product_name IS NOT NULL AND product_name != ''\n            ")
            for row in cursor.fetchall():
                sku = str(row.get('sku') or '').strip()
                color = parse_lingxing_color(str(row.get('product_name') or ''))
                if sku and color:
                    color_map[sku] = color
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.warning(f'读取颜色-领星映射失败: {exc}')
    return color_map
